clips.description: The male counterparts of the sugar-sensing labellar neurons Shiu et al. used, pulsed at 200 Hz for 1 s every 2 s. This is the validated propagation benchmark from stage 0, run for longer so the cascade repeats.
clips.name: sugar_pulses
clips.title: Sugar-neuron stimulation (sensory to motor propagation)

clips.description: Background membrane noise only, at an amplitude above the ignition threshold measured in stage 2. This is the model's only self-sustaining spontaneous state, and the stage 2 result is that it is not biologically plausible: about three quarters of Kenyon cells end up firing above 30 Hz.
clips.name: spontaneous_ignition
clips.title: Spontaneous ignition (whole-brain runaway)

dataset.name: malecns
dataset.weight_scale_source: male CNS connectome paper (Cell 2026, S0092-8674(26)00942-6): calibration of male CNS vs FAFB/FlyWire synapse detection
